"""Utilities for parsing toggle values."""


def parse_toggle(raw):
    """Parse a case-insensitive toggle value.

    Whitespace around the input is ignored.  The accepted values are
    ``on``, ``off``, and ``unset``, which map to ``True``, ``False``, and
    ``None`` respectively.
    """
    if not isinstance(raw, str):
        raise ValueError("toggle value must be a string")

    value = raw.strip().lower()
    if value == "on":
        return True
    if value == "off":
        return False
    if value == "unset":
        return None
    raise ValueError(f"invalid toggle value: {raw!r}")
